content_html:
Thanks for trying Clippy Vision!

If you've installed and used it (even briefly), we'd love your honest feedback. It takes about 5 minutes and directly shapes what we build next.

Feedback form: https://forms.gle/qxqmNBXzJsWGAAe29

Download: https://github.com/protocorn/clippy-vision/releases/latest

We're especially interested in:

  • Whether the "lost context across apps" problem feels real to you
  • Whether you'd keep Clippy running during a normal workday
  • Whether you felt in control of what gets captured
  • Which roadmap direction matters most (MCP integration, capture audit view, privacy redaction, etc.)

Bug reports and feature ideas are also welcome here in the comments, or open a separate issue with details.

Note: Automatic redaction for sensitive apps is still in progress. Pausing capture is the reliable privacy switch today.
